title: Technology Sector Update for 01/07/2019: MU,INTC,MSI,QTRH,AAPL
text:

Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding nearly 1.3% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 2.6%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Micron Technology ( MU ) climbed more than 5% at one point on Monday after the specialty chipmaker said it will be the primary memory provider for fifth-generation EyeQ5 system-on-chip-based EPM5 platform by Intel's ( INTC ) Mobileye unit for fully autonomous vehicles expected to be on the road next year.
In other sector news:
(+) Motorola Solutions ( MSI ) Monday was hanging onto a more than 1.5% rise in recent trading after the networking equipment company said it acquired vehicle-location video company VaaS International Holdings for $445 million in cash and stock in a move intended to widen its command center software offerings.
(-) Quarterhill's ( QTRH ) declined almost 3% on Monday after a district court judge in California late Friday ruled the Canadian technology portfolio company's WiLAN unit has the option to either accept a reduced $10 million in damages or to begin a new trial to determine Apple's liability in its patent fight with the tech giant.
